project.name: WeatherGPT
project.prototype_goal: AI-powered weather decision, activity planning, risk explanation and disaster situational-intelligence prototype using n8n as the orchestration layer.
project.primary_architecture: Browser frontend -> local n8n -> Open-Meteo / NDMA SACHET / NASA EONET / Gemini -> structured intelligence -> frontend
project.frontend_fallback: If n8n weather is unavailable, the browser can call Open-Meteo directly and run a deterministic local risk engine. Gemini and official SACHET still require their respective backend paths.

frontend.design: Original bright tech-festival design inspired at a high level by VIT graVITas: cream paper, electric blue, acid lime, coral, yellow, sky, pink, oversized type, kinetic marquees, orbital motion, floating tickets, bento cards, scroll reveals.

workflows.name: WeatherGPT - Weather Core + Risk Planner
workflows.purpose: Geocodes a city, fetches live forecast + AQI, computes explainable risk, activity scores and best outdoor window.

workflows.name: WeatherGPT - Grounded Gemini Copilot
workflows.purpose: Grounded Gemini copilot. Receives question + weather + derived risk + official alerts and returns an AI answer through Gemini Interactions API.

workflows.name: WeatherGPT - Official SACHET Alerts
workflows.purpose: Reads NDMA SACHET public RSS/CAP feed and performs prototype text matching against city/district/state.

workflows.name: WeatherGPT - Status Healthcheck
workflows.purpose: Simple health-check endpoint used by the frontend n8n connection indicator.

workflows.name: WeatherGPT - Morning Brief Generator (Local)
workflows.purpose: Runs every day around 07:00 to generate a local morning weather brief. Does not send SMS/WhatsApp by default.

workflows.name: WeatherGPT 100 - Citizen Weather Reports
workflows.purpose: Stores/lists citizen-supplied weather observations in n8n workflow static data; explicitly labels them unverified.

workflows.name: WeatherGPT 100 - Map Grid Layers
workflows.purpose: Returns a 3x3 geographic grid scaffold around coordinates. Frontend or future n8n nodes must enrich points with weather values.

workflows.name: WeatherGPT 100 - Recent History Analytics + Anomaly
workflows.purpose: Analyzes a supplied recent temperature series and flags a simple anomaly versus the series mean. It does not itself fetch history.

workflows.name: WeatherGPT 100 - Multi-Model Forecast Verification
workflows.purpose: Computes a prototype confidence score from a supplied list of model temperatures/rain probabilities. Model fetching must be added/wired.

workflows.name: WeatherGPT 100 - Marine Weather Mode
workflows.purpose: Computes marine risk from supplied wave height/period/SST/current data. It is guidance only; upstream marine data fetching must be wired.

workflows.name: WeatherGPT 100 - Flood Guidance
workflows.purpose: Computes a coarse flood guidance level from supplied river discharge and mean discharge. Upstream flood/GloFAS data fetching must be wired.

workflows.name: WeatherGPT 100 - Experimental Local Nowcast
workflows.purpose: Experimental 0-3 hour persistence/trend heuristic from a supplied hourly series. Not an official or trained meteorological model.

workflows.name: WeatherGPT - NASA EONET Disaster Intelligence
workflows.purpose: Fetches open NASA EONET v3 events, extracts latest Point geometry, calculates Haversine distance, and returns events within a configurable radius (500 km default).

data_sources.open_meteo: Current/hourly/daily weather, geocoding, AQI; non-commercial free/open-access tier for prototype, attribution required.
data_sources.ndma_sachet: Official Indian CAP/RSS disaster alerts. Source-integrity channel; official alerts are never replaced by WeatherGPT score.
data_sources.nasa_eonet: NASA EONET API v3 open natural-event catalogue. Used for radius-based situational intelligence; not an official local warning.
data_sources.gemini: Gemini Developer API via Interactions API; default configured model gemini-3.7-flash; API key remains server-side in n8n.
data_sources.osm: Leaflet with OpenStreetMap raster tiles for light interactive prototype use; attribution required and production use must respect tile policy.

truth_boundaries: WeatherGPT risk scores are derived heuristic indicators, not government warnings.
NDMA SACHET is the official Indian alert channel shown by the prototype.
NASA EONET is an open natural-event catalogue and does not replace local emergency authorities.
Citizen reports are unverified community observations.
Marine, flood and experimental nowcast modules are prototype guidance only.
Advanced workflows 07-12 are processor/scaffold modules and are not all directly called by the current main UI.
